purpose: Independently confirm or refute one exact-candidate-ID rank reversal across two batch endpoints. This closes an original confirmation-coverage gap without modifying the original study.

selection_origin.classification: Posthoc S1-selected, prospectively frozen independent confirmation; not part of the original preregistered S2/S4 family.
selection_origin.basis: Use only the completed primary S1 matrix: N=16384 shows the originally predeclared default-versus-a128_r4_l1_np1 contrast reversing between B=1 and B=2048, but the candidate is absent from the small-batch frozen S2 union. Fix this pair and both directions now; no S2/S4 result is a selection input.
selection_origin.no_adaptive_reselection: Do not change the N, batch endpoints, candidate pair, directions, sample count or round count after observing original S2/S4 or this followup. Do not substitute another pair if this one fails.

activation.rule: Start only after all original fixed GPU stages have finished their planned sequence and their status is complete. A resource, monitoring or validity stop in the original sequence does not authorize this followup as a way to continue or replace the stopped original experiment. Retain a hash snapshot of original statuses/gates/selection files at admission.
activation.execution_policy: Root alone schedules remote GPU work. This freeze authorizes the separate bounded followup under the user's comprehensive research request; it does not permit overlap with the original GPU run.

scope.source_policy: Use the same verified measurement binary and original library revision. Only the independent controller/report is new; no changes to primary measurement code or data.

measurement.seed_derivation: Same SHA256 little-endian first-four-byte method as the original study, but this new namespace. Use phase='health' or 'h2_recheck'; input seed is shared within each paired workload/round and differs from original-study seeds.
measurement.execution_metric: Median CUDA-event interval of the frozen-R serialized graph divided by R, immutable-input repeated steady-state full-batch forward; not isolated host API latency.
measurement.process_unit: Every candidate/workload/round is a fresh process and context. Only paired process medians are independent repetitions; 101 graph samples are not 101 independent process replicates.
measurement.order: Seed the two workload endpoint order separately for each round. Default and default_replica bracket the comparator; alternate which baseline ID comes first by round. Use the original deterministic helpers with the new namespace and phase.
measurement.restore: Restore input outside each timed graph sample; retain one-forward and repeated-graph correctness plus bitwise input-stability checks.
measurement.repeat_import_rule: Verify exact source-file SHA, original study identity, same executable and UUID, frozen R entries and their original provenance. Reuse R only, not old timing labels, health pairs or confirmation observations.

health.criteria: All numerical/guard checks pass, every default/replica pair satisfies abs(log(ratio))<=log(1.05), each workload geometric-mean ratio is in [0.98,1.02], and no process first/last-quartile median drift exceeds 5% in either direction. Source/compiler fingerprints must agree for default and replica.

correctness.failure_rule: Any comparator/default/replica numerical, initialization, execution or protocol failure stops this separate study. No A5 candidate-local-failure continuation, replacement, imputation or threshold relaxation is allowed.

guard.negative_control: For every recheck block require default/replica source/compiler equality and abs(log(default/replica))<=log(1.05). No additional 2% aggregate-control threshold is imposed on recheck; that threshold belongs only to health.
guard.drift: No successful process's first-versus-last-quartile median may differ by more than 5% in either direction.
guard.failure_rule: Any foreign compute, memory breach, monitoring/identity failure, failed control or stage-start resource refusal stops this followup with preserved evidence. Never touch another user's process.

statistics.unit: ten paired fresh-process medians per endpoint
statistics.effect: exp(mean(log(reference_median/target_median))) over the ten frozen paired rounds
statistics.test: One-sided paired-log Student-t with df=9; Holm correction across exactly the two predeclared opposite directions.
statistics.interval: Ordinary paired-log Student-t 95% interval, labeled descriptive and not familywise adjusted.
statistics.clear_gain: Point geometric-mean ratio>=1.05 AND Holm-adjusted p<0.05 against the 2% null, plus complete guard/control/correctness validity.
statistics.zero_variance: If paired-log range<=16*float64_epsilon*max(1,maxabs(logratios)), label noninferential/quantization-limited and do not manufacture t/p/CI; use p=1 only for Holm family counting.
statistics.missing: Incomplete or invalid directions remain in the family with p=1 for counting, have no inferential effect/CI, and cannot establish a crossover.
statistics.rank_reversal_claim: Both opposite directions must independently satisfy clear_gain. Otherwise report the observed valid data and uncertainty without claiming a confirmed rank reversal.
statistics.negative_control: Default_replica is a quality control only and is not a benefit hypothesis.
statistics.no_pooling: Never pool these observations, health rows or p-values with original S1/S2/S3/S4; do not revise the original headline family or original frozen-winner primary effect.

reporting.label: Separate posthoc S1-selected independent H2 confirmation
reporting.retain: Frozen design/hash, primary-admission snapshot, original R provenance, every fresh process record and numerical result, raw timing samples, guard logs, exact test family, controller hashes, negative/null/invalid/incomplete outcomes.
reporting.limits: A positive result establishes a pair-specific rank reversal between these two declared workload regimes on this GPU and timing metric. Batch changes working-set/cache conditions as well as parallelism. Do not attribute causality to upload count alone or infer a complex-model requirement, cross-GPU generalization, compile-free correctness certification or end-to-end online selector performance.
reporting.stop_after: One health gate followed by exactly ten rounds per endpoint, or the first defined failure. No pair substitution, additional endpoints, extra rounds until significance, or automatic expansion.
